request.deadline: 12 months; exact dates not stated in document
deliverables: 12 months of part-time maintainer coverage for Pallas after the existing contract closes
Essential maintenance including dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation
Community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, and public communication
AI-friendly documentation and integration resources for AI-driven development workflows

request.recipient: Intersect treasury reserve smart contract stake address for subsequent project-specific smart contract administration on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund Pallas by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Core Rust Libraries, Year 2, including maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for Pallas maintenance, and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.

Pallas is described as a collection of Rust crates implementing core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptography, networking mini-protocols, ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
The document says Pallas is shared infrastructure used by projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC, and others.
The document reports Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 crates.io downloads, with links to GitHub and crates.io for verification.

The maintainer scope includes dependency updates, protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, documentation, issue triage, contribution review, community communication, and AI-friendly documentation resources.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain treasury withdrawal submission.
The proposal asserts the withdrawal does not, at submission time alone or in aggregate, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals in Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

The document says Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified reserve and project-specific addresses, role-based approvals, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard.

Audit and oversight costs are stated to be included in the overhead and administration fee, with independent oversight by Intersect and technically capable third parties using reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The proposal seeks 540,750 ADA for a 12-month continuation of Pallas maintenance by TxPipe, administered through Intersect smart-contract tooling with stated oversight, external references, and adoption metrics.
